frase_gancho.texto: A living mosaic of languages, worldviews, and traditions that beat strongly in contemporary Mexico.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: Welcome to the gateway to the ethnographic floor, a portal devoted to the vibrant diversity of the native communities that inhabit our country. This introductory gallery offers an overview of the linguistic plurality, the settlement patterns, and the cultural heritage shared by more than sixty Indigenous Peoples. Through maps, photographs, clothing, and everyday objects, visitors will understand how ancestral memory is dynamically interwoven with modernity. Here we celebrate resilience, communal work, and the festive expressions that affirm the sense of identity and the human richness of Mexico today.
